name: Necessary Cookies
body: Mailboxsweep.com makes use of cookies (pieces of data stored on behalf of our application in your device's browser storage) to secure access to our service and improve your experience. To protect your privacy, Mailboxsweep only uses cookies that are either strictly necessary for the secure function of the website and application, or cookies that provide anonymous usage information to Mailboxsweep.com to help us improve our product. Our cookies are limited to our domain ('mailboxsweep.com') and will not track you on other websites. We may use third-party tools to create and issue cookies that provide us with usage data, but these tools will not store personal information in these cookies or share their contents with any parties other than Mailboxsweep.
